resources.name: Open-source plane-wave DFT code with LDA and ultrasoft/PAW pseudopotentials for Al (e.g. Quantum ESPRESSO)

access.notes: Any code providing LDA with a suitable Al pseudopotential is acceptable. Originally VASP was used; an open-source equivalent is required for this reproduction.
Standard LDA ultrasoft or PAW pseudopotential for Al, e.g. Al.pz-n-rrkjus_psl.0.1.UPF, appropriate for the chosen DFT code.
